keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «플라스틱 재활용은 길고 어려운 과정이다(주제)» 와 «그래서 플라스틱을 덜 쓰는 것이 재활용만큼 중요하다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (recycling plastic is a long and difficult process) and the conclusion (using less plastic is just as important as recycling it). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Collect, sort, wash, cut, and melt

boxes.qen: Why should we use less plastic?
boxes.a: Only a small part of plastic is recycled

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why is only a small part of all plastic actually recycled?
qs.qko: 왜 전체 플라스틱 중 실제로 재활용되는 것은 일부뿐인가요?
opts: Because people do not take plastic to recycling centers at all
Because of problems like mixed types, dirty plastic, and weaker plastic
Because melted plastic cannot become new products
evs: Because of these problems, only a small part of all plastic is actually recycled.
First, used plastic is collected and taken to a recycling center.
The melted plastic can then be made into new products, such as bottles or clothing.
There, workers and machines sort the plastic into different types.
why: «이런 문제들 때문에» 실제로 재활용되는 것은 일부뿐이라고 했어요. 그 문제는 바로 앞에 나온 섞을 수 없는 종류, 더러운 플라스틱, 약해지는 플라스틱이에요.
The text says «because of these problems» only a small part is recycled. The problems are the many types, dirty plastic, and plastic getting weaker.

qs.q: In "workers and machines sort the plastic into different types," what does "sort" mean?
qs.qko: «workers and machines sort the plastic into different types» 에서 «sort» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: There, workers and machines sort the plastic into different types.
Plastic that is dirty with food or stuck to other materials is also hard to recycle.
Next, the plastic is washed, cut into small pieces, and melted.
That is why using less plastic is just as important as recycling it.
why: 플라스틱을 «여러 종류로(into different types)» 나눈다고 했으니, sort 는 종류별로 나누어 모은다는 뜻이에요.
The plastic is put «into different types», so «sort» means to put things into groups.

qs.q: Why does the text say using less plastic is important?
qs.qko: 글에서 왜 플라스틱을 덜 쓰는 것이 중요하다고 하나요?
opts: Because recycling is hard, so only a little plastic is recycled
Because plastic gets stronger each time it is recycled
Because there is only one type of plastic
evs: Because of these problems, only a small part of all plastic is actually recycled.
The melted plastic can then be made into new products, such as bottles or clothing.
That is why using less plastic is just as important as recycling it.
First, used plastic is collected and taken to a recycling center.
why: 문제가 많아서 재활용되는 플라스틱은 일부뿐이고, «그래서(That is why)» 덜 쓰는 것이 재활용만큼 중요하다고 했어요. 두 문장을 이어야 답이 나와요.
Only a small part is recycled because of the problems, and «that is why» using less plastic is just as important. You need both sentences.

ends: How can we use less plastic at school?
학교에서 플라스틱을 덜 쓰려면 어떻게 할까요?
What happens to plastic that ends up in the ocean?

write.src: “We should <u>use our own water bottles</u> so that <u>we throw away less plastic</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «해야 할 일 + 그러면 생기는 좋은 결과» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and the good result in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있는지» 를 넣어 결과를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: so that we can save energy)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what they can do. (e.g. so that we can save energy)
